Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend certain laws in their application to the
North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 26th
April, 2002]
No. Legis. I(2)76/2623, dated 26-4-2002.--The following Ordinance
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:-
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the North-West Frontier Province (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend certain laws in their application to the
North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 26th
April, 2002]
No. Legis. I(2)76/2623, dated 26-4-2002.--The following Ordinance
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:-
2. Amendment of Act II of 1899.--In the Stamp Act, 1899 (II of
1899), in its application to the North-West Frontier Province, in section 9,--
(i) in clause (a), in its
application to the North-West Frontier Province, the word "and",
appearing at the end, shall be deleted;
(ii) in clause (b), the full-stop
appearing at the end shall be replaced by a comma; and
(iii) after clause (b), so as
amended, the following new clause shall be inserted, namely:
"(c) exempt from payment of
duties, either in whole or in part, in respect of any instrument executed
between the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority and any other body
corporate or company, which is owned or controlled by the Federal Government or
by the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority, engaged in the
generation, transmission or distribution of electric power; provided this
exemption shall be admissible for once only."

Amendment of Act II of 1899

ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XI OF 2002
An Ordinance further to amend certain laws in their application to the
North-West Frontier Province
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P. Extraordinary, 26th
April, 2002]
No. Legis. I(2)76/2623, dated 26-4-2002.--The following Ordinance
by the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province is hereby published for
general information:-
3. Amendment of Act XVI of 1908.--In the Registration Act, 1908
(XVI of 1908), in its application to the North-West Frontier Province, to
section 78, after the existing proviso, the following new proviso shall be
inserted, namely:--
"Provided further that the
Provincial Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, exempt from
payment of registration fees, either in whole or in part, in respect of any
instrument executed between the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority
and any other body corporate or company, which is owned or controlled by the
Federal Government or the Pakistan Water and Power Development Authority
engaged in the generation, transmission or distribution of electric power, only
for once."

(Amendment)
No.
SOR-I(S&GAD)1-117/91(Vol. II) Dated
31st August, 2001
To
(1) All Administrative
Secretaries to Government of N.-W.F.P.
(2) The Secretary to Governor,
N.-W.F.P.
(3) All Heads of Attached
Departments in N.-W.F.P.
(4) All Heads of
Autonomous/Semi-Autonomous Bodies in N.-W.F.P.
(5) All District Coordination
Officers in N.-W.F.P.
(6) The Registrar, Peshawar High

(7) The Secretary, N.-W.F.P.

(8) The Director, Anti-Corruption

(9) The Registrar, N.-W.F.P.
Service Tribunal, Peshawar.
Subject: AMENDMENT IN
RECRUITMENT POLICY
Sir,
I am directed to
refer to the subject cited above and to say that the competent Authority is
pleased to direct that the following further amendment in Reeruitment Policy
issued vide Circular Letters No. SORI(S&GAD)1-117/91, dated 1-2-1993 read
with letter of even number, dated 12-10-1993 shall be made namely:--
"The exiting entries
appearing after the words "be enforced strictly" in para. 1(J) shall
tie .substituted by the following namely:--
"However, 2% quota reserved for female candidates shall
be tilled in on the basis of total strength of the cadre."
